method: Source and regression review plus an actual macOS development-shell forced renderer crash using an isolated temporary profile and synthetic loopback content. Agent factual and language delta review; prior unrelated operational evidence retained. No human reader acceptance or production-account replay claimed.

checks: Forced native renderer crash displays the local recovery document
Retry preserves the latest SPA route
Explicit Reload window returns to the synthetic app document
A recovery-document crash stops with a native error message

capture.kind: Native BrowserWindow.capturePage of the actual post-crash local document, unmodified
capture.review: Inspected: complete heading, explanatory text, current demo origin, Reload window and Check server settings visible without clipping. Native controls intentionally use English in every locale; alt text and captions translated.

limits: The original account-specific allocation pressure was not reproduced.
No Linux/Windows native process was exercised; controller and HTML tests cover platform-independent recovery behavior.
Other renderer/GPU failure causes can remain.
The cache is optional; unsaved changes may be lost in a native renderer crash.
checks: Relevant automated verification recorded in the PR; this record is not a release-publication approval.
retainedFigures: Existing applications figures and their localized text are unchanged and remain applicable: mobile issue panel, PWA installation illustration, desktop settings and device-notification settings. Their article-relative revisions advance to 7; original capture dates and prior operational evidence are retained. The new recovery control has a fresh actual native capture.
